head: a8bb4ea
summary: HALTED at mandatory ownership boundary, not a passed W2 delivery. All 23 handlers and routes are implemented over the existing durable runner/Worker and repositories. Build and format pass; 11 owned integration tests passed, then all 8 final owned fast tests passed including the new lease boundary. The full fast gate had 711 passes and 9 failures; the owned assertion failure was fixed, leaving eight shared fixture/composition failures requiring unowned changes. Three main semantic scenarios were replayed; adjusted 98% replay and improvements-cap gates are not claimed. Everything is committed locally; nothing was pushed.

deviations.what: Stopped before completing the full adjusted replay gate.
deviations.why: Hard stop 1: the mandatory fast gate still requires changing shared fixture routes and placeholder expectations outside the allocated folders. HALT report records exact failures.

deviations.what: Fresh dispatch scopes are supplied by the owned API feature module.
deviations.why: The inherited singleton mediator otherwise retains root-scoped source readers across profile resets. No shared mediator or registration file was changed.

deviations.what: Worker executable and shared publication were reused without modification.
deviations.why: Finite Worker and atomic publication already existed and were proven with actual process/reopen tests, not reimplemented.

deviations.what: The head field names the implementation/report commit preceding this status-only commit.
deviations.why: This avoids a self-referential commit identifier while preserving the exact implementation evidence.

findings: F-18: the recording's disconnected latest-run 404 is replaced by a durable successful manifest; a genuinely never-calculated client remains 404.
The named preview-client-refused recording actually accepted client selection in the synthetic environment; the task instead requires designated-sample-only preview.
Deterministic startup ID draw offsets and validator English propagate through raw replay. No dummy ID draws or message-copying shims were added.
Shared discovery fixtures register draft/batch routes alongside the real endpoints and cause AmbiguousMatchException.
A shared contract test still asserts 501 for a valid reader dry-run that now correctly returns 202.
Standalone provider validation scans handlers without discovering the API feature registrations and cannot resolve feature helpers.
The raw three-scenario wrapper reports 243 group cases, 35 passed and 208 failed before policy/tier handling; this is not the conductor's exact-template adjusted denominator.
An unowned ReadsCalc setup route substitutes capture-failed for a unit variable; the actual recorded rebase URL succeeds with matching numeric results.
open_questions: How should standalone AddApplication/AddInfrastructure/AddTaxCreditRuntime validation discover or supply feature helper registrations?
How does the conductor classify the real-manifest operational count differences without waiving numeric changes? No cap result was claimed.
The shared direct runner reports validation.queries_run=17 versus recorded 20; this numeric difference remains unchanged.

needs_human.item: Expand allocation for shared fixture/composition repairs.
needs_human.why: Five paging cases and one trust case have duplicate endpoints; the rate-limit test expects placeholder 501; standalone provider validation lacks feature registrations. Required files are unowned.

needs_human.item: Complete full fast-suite and all-scenario semantic replay after integration repairs.
needs_human.why: Neither the whole fast gate nor the 98% adjusted replay threshold is green. The narrow improvements register is not a blanket waiver.

needs_human.item: Atomic override intent and recalculation acceptance.
needs_human.why: Existing ports save override and queue batch in separate transactions. A failed enqueue after save can leave intent without accepted work; unchanged resave currently does not repair it.

Default synchronous-compute lease is 600 seconds with entry renewal and precommit checks, not periodic heartbeat. Expiry rollback is tested; long-run sizing and live native schema provisioning are unmeasured.
The inherited behavior can change calculated figures and conflicts with strict year-scoped statutory ownership. It was preserved pending owner decision.

needs_human.item: First-program credit-math behavior for multi-program states.
needs_human.why: Inherited Python-compatible figure-sensitive behavior was preserved; no new refusal or repricing was introduced.
